messages:
Ming (oncall): :rotating_light: ap-southeast1 metrics ingest is flapping — 50% of GPU hosts missing node-exporter since ~23:04 UTC, dashboards mostly empty
Infra-bot: Alert: metrics_ingest_pipeline_error for cluster ap-southeast1 (rate 1.2/s). See: https://ops.redwood.internal/alerts/2245
Jess: on it. quick Q — is this only dashboards blank or are autoscalers getting bad signals?
Samira: both. dashboards blank and HPA saw low cpu/mem metrics and scaled down some inference pods ~23:07. risk of token queueing if sustained.
Ming (oncall): can someone check node-exporter and fluent-bit consumers? last exporter-controller logs showed OOMKill events
Jess: doing quick checks now
Jess: ```kubectl -n infra get pods -l app=node-exporter -o wide
# 3/6 READY, others CrashLoopBackOff
kubectl -n infra logs node-exporter-5f7b -c exporter | tail -n 60
# TLS handshake errors + write timeout + SIGKILL due to oom
```
Samira: exporters configured at 200Mi on GPU hosts. with nvml + host metrics they need more. also kafka metrics-ingest topic shows consumer lag -> backpressure.
Deploy-bot: Deploy triggered 2026-03-18T23:14:10Z: increase node-exporter memory limits to 512Mi and replicas to 4 (PR #4321)
Michael: long-term we should tune memory per host-type, but short-term options: A) bump exporter resources and restart (fast). B) reroute apac telemetry to eu-west ingest cluster (adds latency and egress). C) cold-start prewarm GPUs in apac to handle possible token queueing.
Lina: rerouting will double egress for those metrics for a window — costy. prewarm GPUs adds hourly cost but keeps ingress local. prefer A for immediate recovery + followup on routing if it recurs.
Ming (oncall): priority is to avoid user-facing queueing. plan: A now, B as fallback. Jess, restart with higher limits and backoff.
Jess: restarted node-exporter deployment with bumped resources and tweaked liveness/readiness backoffs:
```kubectl -n infra set resources deployment/node-exporter --limits=memory=512Mi --requests=memory=256Mi && kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/node-exporter```
Infra-bot: Consumer lag on metrics topic decreasing. ingestion rate normalizing (within 90s). Alert resolved.
Samira: HPA now receiving metrics again, scaled pods back up to expected. verified no token queue growth.
Ming (oncall): Follow-ups: 1) increase default node-exporter memory for GPU hosts in config repo, 2) add exponential backoff on ingest retry logic, 3) add unit/integration test to simulate exporter OOM and kafka consumer lag. Filed OPS-1189.
Michael: add cost estimate for memory increases + optional prewarm GPUs to OPS-1189, cc:billing. include delta per-hour and per-day for ap-southeast1.
Lina: noted. will prepare cost calc and attach to ticket.
Ming (oncall): thanks team. will do short RCA draft and post in ops channel tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
